subject: Post-call: FinTechCorp security & incident response follow-up
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amira Hassan <amira.hassan@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: FinTechCorp security & incident response follow-up

Hi Amira — great speaking earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery:  

- Primary security asks you flagged: SOC 2 status, GDPR applicability, potential HIPAA concerns (data residency for specific product flows), and vendor security questionnaire initiation.  
- Incident response / breach notification: you asked about our notification timelines and BCP/DR evidence.

Ask: can you confirm the point-of-contact (security@fintechcorp.com is fine) and the timeline you need for initial notification (some customers require within 24 hours of detection)? We want to make sure we align on expectations.

Next steps I propose:
1) Laura (cc) will share our SOC 2 / BCP overview and a completed vendor questionnaire draft.
2) Rishi can spell out incident response timelines and evidence we can provide (RTO/RPO, tabletop results, backup verification).
3) Amira to confirm any additional compliance constraints (e.g., HIPAA required controls) and an internal timeline for vendor review.

Attachments: SOC2-in-progress-summary.pdf (Redwood summary), vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx (blank copy) — Laura / Rishi, please attach your files.

Thanks — I’ll book a short follow-up next week to close the open items and capture any redlines so we can progress the PO.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com)

From: Amira Hassan <amira.hassan@fintechcorp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: FinTechCorp Security Team <security@fintechcorp.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: FinTechCorp security & incident response follow-up

Thanks for the recap, Jordan — appreciate the clear plan. A few notes from our side:  

- SOC 2: FinTechCorp is currently completing SOC 2 Type II; expected completion and report delivery is targeted for 2026-07-15. We understand vendors may have SOC 2 earlier; please provide your latest evidence.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We are subject to GDPR for EU customers. We are not a covered entity under HIPAA, but we do have some customers with PHI considerations; we will flag which flows need additional controls if we proceed.
- Incident notification: our security policy requires vendor notification within 24 hours of detection for incidents that could impact our data (we can be flexible on time of day for initial notification but need an initial acknowledgment + triage ETA within 24 hours).
- Vendor questionnaire: attaching our initial vendor questionnaire for your team to review. We also included a contact (security@fintechcorp.com) for any follow-up.

Attaching: FinTech_Vendor_Risk_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx

Amira Hassan
Senior Manager, Vendor Risk
FinTechCorp
(amira.hassan@fintechcorp.com)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amira Hassan <amira.hassan@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-13T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: FinTechCorp security & incident response follow-up

Hi Amira — thanks for the details and for the questionnaire. Quick responses and what we’re attaching here:  

- SOC 2: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II report (most recent assessment: 2024-11-30). We can provide a redacted report and ISO-style summary; attaching a SOC2-in-progress-summary.pdf (high-level controls + scope) for now. If you need the full report, we can execute an NDA / AFA if required.
- BCP/DR evidence: attaching BCP_DR_evidence_overview.pdf with our RTO/RPO SLAs, recovery locations, tabletop cadence, and backup validation cadence.
- Vendor questionnaire: I’ve started filling the vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx with our standard answers (see marked cells). Please let us know any questions or follow-ups.
- Incident notification: our standard timeline is to provide initial notification within 48 hours of confirming an incident and to provide a remediation timetable and root cause as we have it. Per your requirement for 24-hour notification on detection, Rishi — can you confirm whether we can commit to initial acknowledgment/notification within 24 hours of detection (even if the full analysis takes longer)?

If helpful, we can carve out a short call between security teams to align on acceptable SLAs for notification and what evidence you require for vendor acceptance.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Security & Compliance (Solutions)
Redwood Inference
(laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com)

---
Attachments referenced: SOC2-in-progress-summary.pdf, BCP_DR_evidence_overview.pdf, vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amira Hassan <amira.hassan@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-13T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: FinTechCorp security & incident response follow-up

Hi Amira / Jordan / Laura — looping in the incident response specifics from engineering/IR perspective. We reviewed FinTechCorp requirements and can confirm the following commitments and evidence we can provide if you move forward with Redwood:  

- Initial detection -> acknowledgement: We will send initial vendor notification within 24 hours of detection (acknowledgment includes high-level impact assessment and next steps).
- Triage/initial actions: initial triage and containment actions within 4 hours of detection when staff are available.
- Remediation plan: aim to publish a remediation plan within 72 hours of detection with an ETA for fixes/mitigation.
- Forensic report: we will provide a formal incident report (timeline, impact, root cause, mitigations) within 21 calendar days, and follow up with any longer-term fixes and POA&Ms.
- BCP/DR evidence: we are attaching BCP_DR_evidence_overview.pdf and can provide backup verification logs under a data-sharing agreement; RTO targets are 4 hours for critical inference endpoints, RPO is 1 hour for critical stateful caches (details in attachment).
- Data residency / HIPAA: we support regional routing and can work with you on restricted-region deployments; for PHI flows, we recommend the private deployment option or restricted routing + contractual language.

I’ve attached the vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx with Rishi-engineering notes in the comment cells and BCP_DR_evidence_overview.pdf. If you need SLA language in a PO, we can propose a tailored clause for the incident notification timeline.

Thanks — happy to join a security-to-security call.

— Rishi
Staff Engineer, Security & Platform
Redwood Inference
(rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com)

---
Attachments referenced: vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx (partially completed), BCP_DR_evidence_overview.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>

Thanks everyone — and thanks Amira for the quick turnaround. Proposed mutual action plan (MAP) and next steps:  

1) Redwood to upload redacted SOC 2 Type II summary and BCP/DR overview (attached) — DONE (Laura/Rishi). Due: 2026-05-13.
2) FinTechCorp to review vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx and send any questions / required clarifications. Due: 2026-05-18.
3) Security-to-security sync: schedule 30-min call to align on notification SLAs and evidence exchange (proposed slot: 2026-05-20 09:00-09:30 PT). Jordan to send invite.
4) If SOC2 full report or NDA required for full disclosure, Jordan to coordinate AFA/NDA execution. Due: 2026-05-21.
5) Finalize contractual language for incident notification timeline (24-hour initial notice) and any PHI routing requirements. Expect to capture as redlines to SOW/Exhibit. Due: 2026-05-25.

Can you confirm the 2026-05-20 slot or suggest alternatives? Also confirm the list above is complete from your perspective and any additional artifacts you need before the call.

Thanks — Jordan
